project_extensions.scope: Statistical transfer and archive guard; collider event generation or detector assumptions are out of scope here.

acceptance_criteria: Exact ATLAS SUSY-2019-08 HEPData version 4 cutflows t42–t50 and full v4/r3 model, same mass pair and mCT bins.
Compare terminal weighted counts within a half-unit of their published decimal precision in all nine bins.
Apply native pyhf with all eight channels and exact original signal template; mu=1 minus mu=0 agrees with the raw signal within 1e-9 events.
Reject wrong table/hash and deliberately misplaced bin; complete JSON byte replay. No fit, detector recast, or new limit.
